race.comment: RIPPED RITCHIE (2) has been out of the placings last couple but impressed when clocking a 17.39 over 300m at this track three starts back. Can measure up again if runs up to recent best times. KODA MULWEE (5) turned in a plain performance last time when sixth at Gosford over 388m behind Bring The Beers (22.73) in a Grade 4/5. Can do much better this time. ZIPPING AMOS (1) was crowded for room and fell at The Gardens last time but prior to that was a 17.56 winner in a Grade 5. May be worth another try. JUNGLE MASTER (6) jumps at a shorter journey and still warrants respect.
